full.en: WATEROUTCOFFEEmix,125g. Coffee mix with Cactinea™, which helps to eliminate water from the body and protects cells from oxidative stress. Ingredients: tapioca starch, instant coffee (Coffea arabica L., seed) (20%), Cactinea™ (Opuntia ficus-indica), stabiliser: cellulose. Using advice: pour 5 g (1 teaspoon) of the powder with 200 mL of warm water. Storage: store in a cool and dry place. Keep out of reach of children! This product is not a substitute for a balanced and varied diet and a healthy lifestyle.
full.sl: WATEROUT COFFEE mešanica, 125 g. Kavna mešanica s Cactinea™, ki pomaga pri izločanju vode iz telesa in ščiti celice pred oksidativnim stresom. Sestavine: tapiokin škrob, instant kava (Coffea arabica L.) (20%), Cactinea™ (Opuntia ficusindica), stabilizator: celuloza. Način uporabe: 5 g (1 čajno žličko) prelijte z 200 mL tople vode. Shranjevanje: hranite v suhem in hladnem prostoru. Hranite izven dosega otrok! Ta izdelek ni nadomestilo za uravnoteženo in raznoliko prehrano ter zdrav način življenja.

Ovaj proizvod nije zamjena za uravnoteženu i raznoliku prehranu te zdrav način života.
